_comment: Tests deliberately skipped at the current Phase. Each `reason` names the work that lifts the skip. Phases 0-4 done (43/72 active passes); remaining 29 skips are deeper Phase-4 fixes (path_filestat_get symlink LinkTarget detection works but downstream path_unlink_file/path_open of symlinks still need work; fd_readdir cookie layout; trailing-slash semantics; etc.).

skip.reason: Phase 4: fd_write on bad fd needs proper errno (assemblyscript abort)
Phase 4: pwrite to an existing file traps — likely fd_pwrite stream interaction
Phase 4.x: directory FD rights need own-vs-inherited split — currently dir grants FD_SEEK so PathOpen can pass it down to files

Phase 4.x: OFLAGS_DIRECTORY + FD_WRITE-only rights should ISDIR; pre-check conflicts with the open_scratch_directory pattern that passes a preopen's full rights including FD_WRITE — needs the own/inherited rights split too
Phase 4: rights enforcement on path_open OFLAGS_TRUNC
